title: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend work on a white-label travel booking platform used by loyalty programs: hotels, cars, flights, activities, dining, a shopping cart and trip management, served to several brands in several languages.
highlights: Led investigation of user-facing bugs across a large multi-tenant Nx monorepo (dozens of shared libraries, one storefront serving many brands).
Owned localization checks across six locales, fixing locale-specific UI rendering and HTML string formatting.
Shipped accessibility work (WCAG 2.x): replaced an expired-session banner with an accessible alert dialog across air, hotel and car, and fixed screen-reader announcements in the date picker.
Built an accessible image gallery lightbox and rebuilt the cart's handling of price changes and unavailable items after offers are re-verified.
Validated releases with Jest, Playwright and Storybook, and diagnosed environment and site-specific rendering issues on Vercel deployments.
growth: My first senior title: moved from building features to owning quality, accessibility and localization across a codebase many teams share.
